references.text: Ajin is mentioned as a city in the inheritance of the tribe of Judah, which was later given to the Levites.
Jutta is mentioned as a city in the hill country of Judah, which was later assigned to the priests.
Beth-Shemesh is mentioned as a city on the border of Judah, which was given to the descendants of Aaron.
Parallel account in Chronicles describing the same Levitical cities given from the tribes of Judah and Simeon.
Beth-Shemesh is mentioned in the story of the ark of the covenant being returned from the Philistines, highlighting its significance as a Levitical city.
The introduction to the list of cities given to the descendants of Aaron from the tribes of Judah and Simeon.
